## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

1. Global Risk Regime?
RISK-OFF with weak breadth: Breadth: 2/11 sectors positive. Confirmations: credit stress rising via HYG (1W: -0.29% | 1M: -0.80%) & LQD (1W: -0.69% | 1M: -1.72%) BELOW TREND, broad equity weakness with SPY (1W: -0.94% | 1M: -1.61%) BELOW TREND, and sector breadth skewed to only Energy and Utilities.

2. Primary Risk Drivers?
Credit stress rising: HYG/LQD ratio (Level: 0.7302) ↓ falling, signaling tighter credit conditions. Stocks vs Bonds weakening: SPY/TLT (1W: -1.17% | 1M: +0.62%) ↓ falling CORRECTION, while oil/commodity surge (BNO (1W: +13.90% | 1M: +54.91%) ABOVE TREND; USO (1W: +12.26% | 1M: +55.92%) ABOVE TREND) is driving market dispersion.

3. Financial Conditions Signal?
Neutral-to-tight: Dollar strength is ABOVE TREND (Level: 27.6800 | 1W: +0.47% | 1M: +2.86%) and TLT (1W: -0.94% | 1M: -2.21%) BELOW TREND points to higher yields and tighter conditions; overall financial conditions edging restrictive.

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

4. Sector Leadership?
Energy leading: XLE (1W: +5.23% | 1M: +7.65%) ABOVE TREND; Utilities showing relative strength: (XLU 1W: +0.96% | 1M: +1.44%) ABOVE TREND. Broad weakness across cyclical sectors — Industrials/XLI (1W: -2.15% | 1M: -5.32%) BELOW TREND and Tech/XLK (1W: -0.16% | 1M: -0.01%) BELOW TREND; Style: mixed / no clear leadership.

5. US vs Global?
US soft: SPY (1W: -0.94% | 1M: -1.61%) BELOW TREND. EM/China showing short-term RECOVERY: FXI (1W: +0.82% | 1M: -3.76%) RECOVERY and EEM (1W: +0.12% | 1M: -3.88%) RECOVERY, while Europe/FEZ (1W: -1.03% | 1M: -6.49%) BELOW TREND.

6. Speculative Appetite?
Speculative pockets concentrated in crypto and large-caps: IBIT (1W: +6.45% | 1M: +8.47%) ABOVE TREND and ETHA (1W: +13.90% | 1M: +13.60%) ABOVE TREND, while small caps IWM (1W: -1.31% | 1M: -4.91%) BELOW TREND show risk aversion.

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

7. Commodities Theme?
Commodity-driven market: Oil ETFs USO (1W: +12.26% | 1M: +55.92%) ABOVE TREND and BNO (1W: +13.90% | 1M: +54.91%) ABOVE TREND dominating performance; copper CPER (1W: -2.41% | 1M: -0.98%) BELOW TREND and gold GLD (1W: -3.89% | 1M: -0.72%) BELOW TREND lagging.

8. Energy Trend?
Energy strong on breakout and volatility: XLE (1W: +5.23% | 1M: +7.65%) ABOVE TREND; natural gas UNG (1W: -0.57% | 1M: -1.93%) BELOW TREND — monitor commodity flows for macro spillover.

## 🧭 STRATEGY

9. Trend Confirmation?
CONFIRMED: Weak breadth (2/11) and rising credit stress (HYG/LQD ↓) with SPY below trend align with RISK-OFF. DIVERGENCE: VXX (1W: -5.10% | 1M: +9.37%) CORRECTION and strong commodity ETFs (USO/BNO) create a tactical dispersion risk to watch.

10. Portfolio Direction?
Reduce exposure to broad equity beta: SPY (1W: -0.94% | 1M: -1.61%) BELOW TREND and IWM (1W: -1.31% | 1M: -4.91%) BELOW TREND; favor defensive/commodity exposures showing strength — XLU (1W: +0.96% | 1M: +1.44%) ABOVE TREND and monitor XLE (1W: +5.23% | 1M: +7.65%) ABOVE TREND — bonds neutral to monitor given TLT (1W: -0.94% | 1M: -2.21%) BELOW TREND.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Sectors to Watch?
BULLISH: XLE (1W: +5.23% | 1M: +7.65%) ABOVE TREND; XLU (1W: +0.96% | 1M: +1.44%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: XLI (1W: -2.15% | 1M: -5.32%) BELOW TREND; XLY (1W: -1.54% | 1M: -4.41%) BELOW TREND.

12. Commodities to Watch?
BULLISH: BNO (1W: +13.90% | 1M: +54.91%) ABOVE TREND; USO (1W: +12.26% | 1M: +55.92%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: CPER (1W: -2.41% | 1M: -0.98%) BELOW TREND; UNG (1W: -0.57% | 1M: -1.93%) BELOW TREND.

13. Key Levels?
VXX 31.99 (1W: -5.10% | 1M: +9.37%) CORRECTION — watch volatility regime. HYG/LQD 0.7302 ↓ falling (credit health); XLK/XLF 2.8156 (Tech vs Financials) — monitor for style pivot. Breadth: 2/11 sectors positive as a tactical risk flag.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

RISK-OFF with weak breadth: 2/11 sectors positive. Energy (XLE 1W: +5.23% | 1M: +7.65%) and Utilities (XLU 1W: +0.96% | 1M: +1.44%) showing relative strength. Key risk is rising credit stress (HYG/LQD 0.7302 ↓) and dispersion from commodity-driven moves plus VXX divergence (1W: -5.10% | 1M: +9.37%) to monitor.
